acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements for home remodeling can vary by city and the type of work being done. In cities such as Meridian or Eagle, permits are usually necessary for structural changes, additions, major electrical or plumbing work, and sometimes even for extensive interior renovations. It's crucial to consult with your contractor or local building department before starting any work to understand specific regulations and avoid potential delays or fines.
